post.originalText:
Someone who's usually all-in on ChatGPT (two 20x accounts) tried Opus 5.5 on the cheapest paid plan (€20/mo Pro).

Attached the prompt below

Opus did it in one 5hr session, granted Codex full permissions, even pulled Suno for music/SFX. Multiplayer, stats, bots or humans, proximity voice, destroyable assets, dogs and cats, weather. Uploaded the server, set Cloudflare, OP touched nothing. Playable in browser, ~2MB without the mp3s. Houston, we have a problem: Opus 5.5.

Reddit: https://t.co/CxDoqxcXCQ
